decisions.reason: As a peripheral and easily substitutable mobile app with limited visible evidence after launch, it is the weakest of several adjacent options and is likely to be cut so resources can be focused elsewhere.

This broader passenger-processing technology line fits the firm’s integrated airport security offering and, as a flexible option with several models, is worth keeping while market demand continues to clarify.

Although relevant to airport efficiency, this self-service check-in solution appears to overlap with the stronger passenger-processing line and likely has higher carrying costs, making discontinuation more likely.
